verdict.rationale: Graphite offers 'comment exclusions' and 'custom rules' letting developers manually configure the AI reviewer to stop leaving certain kinds of comments, which can approximate 'the reviewer learns' — but this is a manual rule-writing workaround, not an automatic learning loop triggered by pushing back in a review thread. missing for 10: evidence of automatic memory/learning from in-thread pushback, evidence that a rejected comment is not repeated without manual rule creation, any hands-on/community confirmation this actually works as claimed.
